name: Auto Deafen
description: Presses a keybind (e.g. your Discord deafen keybind) when you reach a chosen percent in a level.

target-percent.name: Deafen at percent
target-percent.description: The level percent at which the keybind is pressed.

keybind.name: Keybind
keybind.description: Must match your Discord deafen keybind. Examples: F10, Ctrl+Shift+D, Alt+F8, Ctrl+Numpad1

undeafen.name: Undeafen on death / exit / complete
undeafen.description: Presses the keybind again to undeafen when the attempt ends. Needed since Discord's keybind is a toggle.
